# Upstream permissions and exact missing inputs

Status: dependency proposal; no numerical permission granted.
Owner decisions: D001–D005 in the [ledger](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md).
Every missing object below blocks the affected numerical route or claim, not
necessarily preparation of its definition.

| ID | Required object and scientific owner | Already bound | Exact outstanding permission or evidence | Blocked use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U01 | Original measured ancestry and RTC/CAL/AST realization; respective producer owners | Frozen FRUIT requires immutable ancestry, exact quantity/reference, sample association and state. | One observation ID and exact input/calibration/geometry/RTC records; units, beam/template/spectral convention, sample axes/timing and validity; authoritative pre-removal input. No observation is selected here. | Any numerical iteration or physical-input response. |
| U02 | Residual PTC operation and coefficient/QC family; PTC owner | Frozen PTC application mathematics is already admitted. Frozen JINC requires a selected, registered, realized positive analysis/gridding family with explicit JINC permission and compatible QC. | Exact PTC cleaning/centering/grouping/rank/support and learning/application rules; separate analysis/gridding family, request/default authority, values and QC generation. Modal application coordinates are not this family. MAP permission alone is insufficient. | Residual operation and numeric JINC contribution. |
| U03 | FRUIT model/removal/rejoin and transformed-input handoff to JINC; FRUIT plus affected PTC/JINC/AST owners | FRUIT may bind operation placement and generations; JINC binds exact PTC output and same-processed-sample coordinates. | Explicit accepted relation between residual PTC output, rejoined descendant, retained/recomputed coefficient and coordinate/QC identities. Determine whether an exact existing authority suffices or a controlled successor is required. Do not relabel the rejoined array as an unchanged PTC product. | Calling the proposed rejoined-signal route admitted under the ordinary PTC-to-JINC handoff. |
| U04 | Forward JINC numerical realization; JINC owner | JINC v0.1/r0.3 defines the observation-only signed operator and fixed bundle. Its exact SCI-VAL registration/source lock already exists under the freeze manifest. | JINC-permitted realized PTC family; owner-authorized TolTEC array parameter set; exact numerical-adequacy profile and matching realization certificate wherever numerical support is claimed. Recovery does not supply these. | Numerical JINC availability, adequacy or implementation conformity. |
| U05 | Model-to-sample projection and model companions; FRUIT and each companion producer | The generic core permits typed Pi/F/B only. JINC base output is N, C, Q, normalized m with support/validity, and coefficient-squared time. | Exact projection, additive/reference conversion and distinct path support rules. If the chosen selector needs RMS/noise, kernel/template or weight companions, bind their quantity, producer method, source generation and permitted use. The base JINC bundle supplies no variance, formal weight, empirical noise, significance, response or covariance by implication. | Numerical selection/projection and any companion-dependent claim. |
| U06 | Response and uncertainty methods; FRUIT for transformation, NOI for ensemble/uncertainty | Frozen seven-role response catalog and law-relative uncertainty boundaries, including repaired RF-01/02 fixed-map conditioning. | Exact perturbation law/domain and maps/state; full recurrence/terminal conditioning where requested. A NOI route also needs its own accepted method/parents, zero-law action and member parity. | U07 | Compact-source pointing scientific use; Pointing/source-inference owner | FRUIT records facts and terminal lineage; downstream admission is separately owned. | A later exact target, estimator, source/beam convention, response/uncertainty dependencies and named-use policy. | U08 | Historical executable/control realization; project and scientific owners | Historical source and recovered recurrence are exact. Historical control remains mandatory for empirical comparison. | Preserved executable/environment or separately approved pinned reconstruction; ordered configuration and original inputs; continuation/stochastic state if used; paired control endpoint and comparison tolerance predeclared before any run. | A reproducible historical numerical control or any claim of numerical identity. |

This is a bounded dependency closure proposal, not permission to create new
PTC/JINC/NOI methods. The next paper-only pass would return concrete definitions
and exact owner questions for U01–U08. No independent upstream estimator is
invented inside FRUIT. A substantive upstream successor needs its own recorded
owner decision and version; frozen sources remain unchanged.

Raw observation JINC is recommended because it keeps coadd and post-map-filter
science outside this first scope. It does not remove the dependencies above.
If the route requires broader science than the owner approves, report that
specific unavailable route and stop that design. Do not switch to MAP,
filtered/coadded products or another population silently.
